title: LUMEN & SALT
oneLine: Pilot a tethered bathyscaphe down the Halcyon Trench: grapple drifting wrecks, cut the salvage free, mind the weight of it, and surface before the air runs out.
goal: Surface with $1,500 banked to close the salvage contract. Every dive you choose how deep to go and when to turn back; below 75 m the Black Shelf pays more per piece and costs more air, more current and its own hazards.
loseCondition: Run ends when hull integrity or oxygen reaches zero. Both are shown in the HUD, and both are finite.
winCondition: Bank $1,500 across any number of dives and the contract-complete screen appears.

controls.A / D or Left / Right: lateral thrust; the bathyscaphe accelerates and coasts, no instant snap
controls.W / S or Up / Down: vent (rise) or flood (sink) ballast; venting all the way is the fast ascent
controls.hold left mouse button: fire the grapple toward the pointer; keep holding to stay tethered, release to let go
controls.hold E: cut the nearest salvage piece free while tethered to its wreck
controls.F: switch the lamp; the cone lights the wreck and the salvage, and wakes the lures

systems.oxygen: The clock of every dive. Drain is 0.62/s plus 0.0125/s per metre of depth, so the deep tiers cost real air. Surfacing refills the tank.
systems.ballast: Ballast runs 0..1 with 0.5 neutral. Buoyancy pushes up when vented and down when flooded, so the ascent speed is the ballast setting, not a fixed rate.
systems.tether: The hook flies at 1550 px/s up to 560 px. Once attached, a spring (stiffness 10.5) pulls the diver toward the anchor, the wreck feels 18% of that pull, and a tether stretched 250 px past its rest length snaps.
systems.salvage: Four kinds (copper coil, amber glass, silver ingot, trench relic) with own mass and value; each wreck's depth tier scales value x1, x1.3, x1.7, x2.2. Carried pieces slow thrust and add sink, so a rich hold is a slow ascent.
systems.wrecks: Each wreck holds 2-4 pieces and 2+tier integrity. Every cut frees a piece and costs integrity; at zero the hull buckles and collapses after 2.1 s, damaging anything inside 190 px and destroying the pieces still attached.
systems.lures: Bioluminescent drifters on a deterministic patrol. The lamp wakes one within 380 px and it chases at 122 px/s; with the lamp off it forgets the diver in 2.4 s.
systems.currents: Bands every 620 px push the diver and nudge the wrecks, drawn as streaks so they can be read before entering.
systems.refits: Ten refits, three offered after each surfacing. Three of them are trades, not upgrades: Light servo (+18% thrust, +12% air burn), Deep hull (+40 hull, -25 s of air) and Sweep lens (+30% cut range and +15% cut speed, but lures notice the lamp 30% further).
systems.score: Banked dollars are the score. The best haul is kept in localStorage and shown on the title and end screens.
systems.environmentBands: Two depth bands. Above 75 m is the UPPER TRENCH; at 75 m and below the water becomes the BLACK SHELF: currents scale x1.55, wrecks spawn 42% denser (spawnGap), salvage pays x1.34, silt vents and pressure wells start spawning, and the renderer tints the water violet and pulls the lamp back to 510 px.
systems.siltVents: Telegraphed columns on an 8 s cycle: 4.8 s idle, 1.4 s warning (the mouth turns amber and silt rises), 1.8 s blast (an upward plume 220 px tall and 96 px wide). Inside the plume the diver takes 10 damage and is pushed up 190 px/s. No random damage: the warning is the window to cross or steer round.
systems.pressureWells: A 9 s cycle: 3.5 s rest, 1.5 s warning (rings contract), 4 s pull. Inside the 180 px radius the well adds a pull toward its core, strongest at the centre; a diver inside the 29 px core takes 14 damage. The outer ring is always escapable with thrust, so it is a positioning hazard, not a coin flip.
systems.combo: Each piece cut inside a 7.5 s window raises the multiplier by 0.25, to x2.5. The window decays in real time, so a combo is only worth chasing while the wreck is safe; the HUD shows the multiplier and the time left.
systems.feel: Held input is sampled every frame; a tap of E or the mouse is buffered for 130 ms so a press shorter than a fixed step is never lost. A 1.15 s dive-start sequence holds the diver at the hatch (the run clock does not advance) with the tank and hull read out. Hits trigger a 70 ms hit-stop, a hull flash and shake.

loop: Title screen: goal, controls, best haul.
Dive-start sequence: the hatch holds for 1.15 s, then the diver is released.

Dive: descend, read the band (the Black Shelf is richer and rougher), grapple a wreck, cut salvage free, hold the combo, dodge lures, read vents and wells, manage ballast and air, decide when to surface.
Surface: cargo is banked, the haul is added to the contract total.
Refit screen: one of three upgrades, then the next, deeper dive.
Contract complete at $1,500, or a run over screen on hull breach or an empty tank; SPACE restarts instantly.

files.game/index.html: the page: canvas, status line, module entry
files.game/src/main.js: boot, fixed-step loop, screen state machine, audio cues, debug hooks for tests
files.game/src/config.js: every tuning number, palette and player-facing line
files.game/src/world.js: the run: dive state, spawn director, step composition, surfacing, scoring
files.game/src/player.js: bathyscaphe physics: ballast, buoyancy, thrust, drag, oxygen, hull
files.game/src/grapple.js: hook flight, tether spring tension and snap, cut progress
files.game/src/hazards.js: lures: patrol, lamp-woken chase, recoil after a hit
files.game/src/salvage.js: salvage table, depth-tier value, cargo mass
files.game/src/upgrades.js: the ten refits (seven straight upgrades, three trades) and the offer roll
files.game/src/particles.js: bubbles, silt, sparks and debris pools
files.game/src/render.js: scene painter: water, depth marks, wrecks, lures, tether, diver, lamp cone
files.game/src/hud.js: HUD: oxygen, hull, depth, cargo, banked, tether tension, timers, prompts
files.game/src/screens.js: overlays: title, pause, refit choice, game over, contract complete
files.game/src/shots.js: deterministic staging for the four screenshot scenes
files.game/src/input.js: keyboard and pointer state, one-shot action flags
files.game/src/audio.js: WebAudio synthesis: no audio files, every cue generated
files.main.ts: the entrypoint: copies game/ and screenshots/ to /output and writes dossier.json
files.game/src/environment.js: depth bands: current scale, wreck density, salvage scale, hazard spawn chances
files.game/src/currents.js: current band generation and force sampling
files.game/src/pressure-wells.js: pressure wells: rest, warning, pull, and core damage
files.game/src/economy.js: salvage combo: multiplier, decay window, value payout

performance.step: fixed 1/60 s; rendering is separate and reads the state
performance.pools: particles are fixed-size pools, no per-frame allocation of objects in the hot loop
performance.hazards: vents and wells are stepped in the fixed step; each is O(1) per instance and capped by spawn density

originality: All names, art, sound and systems are written for this entry: no engine, no library, no sampled audio or borrowed art.

testing.logic: node test/logic.test.mjs — headless fixed-step tests over oxygen, tether, grapple, cutting, weight, hazards, ascent, score, refits and restart
testing.browser: python3 test/browser_test.py — Playwright/Firefox under Xvfb against a local static server: start, move, grapple, cut, take damage, surface, refit, restart, menus, zero page errors
testing.capture: python3 tools/capture.py — the four screenshots, from the same static server
testing.tuning: node tools/autoplay.mjs 16 — a naive bot plays 16 seeds; the pass keeps it beatable but not free
